title: Ship AI apps fast with Rayfin, a new managed backend as a service
description:
Build a field technician productivity app with Rayfin using coding agents. Generate a full-stack app on Microsoft Fabric without manually configuring backend services, then connect to OneLake to surface service insights in the experience. Leave with a working app and a repeatable pattern to ship data-driven, production-ready apps faster, without backend complexity.

Add this session to your schedule to reserve your seat, as capacity is limited. Please arrive at least 5 minutes early; unclaimed seats may be released to standby attendees.
